de: The Library of Congress in Washington, D.C., burns.

dz: 中伯战争:战争以清朝永远从缅甸撤军而结束.
de: Sino-Burmese War: The war ends with the Qing dynasty withdrawing from Burma forever.

dz: 教皇霍诺利乌斯三世通过教皇的确认圣谕批准多明我会骑士团.

dz: 在英格兰国王亨利一世去世后三周,布卢瓦的斯蒂芬宣称拥有王位并被私人加冕为英格兰国王,开始英国无政府主义.
de: Three weeks after the death of King Henry I of England, Stephen of Blois claims the throne and is privately crowned King of England, beginning the English Anarchy.

dz: 达姆甘地震：波斯城市达姆甘附近发生的地震估计造成 20 万人死亡，这是历史上第六次最严重的地震。
de: Damghan earthquake: An earthquake near the Persian city of Damghan kills an estimated 200,000 people, the sixth deadliest earthquake in recorded history.
